scope: Observed failures/warnings/capture limits retained without success-only erasure

gaps.boundary: Earlier exit1/order-drift guard failure retained before mutation; subsequent serial mapping receipt is a separate successful observation, not erasure of the failed attempt.

gaps.selected_runner: Root check-selected.ts persists stdout only. No selected-check stderr files were found; absence of files is not evidence that every successful command stderr stream was empty.
gaps.consumer_runner: Root check-consumers.ts persists nonempty successful stderr. No absent-file observation is used to erase any persisted diagnostic.
gaps.outside_scope: Failures/logs outside these bounded selected-check/consumer/read-model/mapping/scope operations are not certified absent.
